views.title: Rear seating
views.note: Duplicate wood liners removed. Seats and rolled frames clear the wall. The rear bench stays at the normal saloon height.

views.title: Rear entrance
views.note: Wood entrance baffles remain beside the stairwell, with a clear aisle and clear seat frames.

views.title: Front exterior
views.note: Higher passenger-window transoms and aligned sash catches. The rounded cab, readable markings and body finish are retained.

views.title: Rear exterior
views.note: Rounded rear, seven-seat nook, ventilation panels and lamp clusters.

views.title: Roof equipment
views.note: Longer trolley equipment tray, porcelain supports, guard rails, cable conduit and walkway edges.

views.title: Full cabin
views.note: Continuous stainless seat surrounds, corrected wall/sill clearance and detailed floor access covers.

views.title: Cab fittings
views.note: Sprung wiper links, blade backing and washer jets on the curved windshield.
